description:
Get a product's captured flow: every step in order with title, notes, page url, observed
transitions (button labels and where they lead) and which steps are alternate branches, plus
the handoffId for build_handoff. Use it to study how a product structures signup, onboarding
or a task; then get_screen_image on the steps you will copy.

productId.description: Product id from list_products, e.g. linear, stripe or airbnb.

name: get_flow
title: Get a product's onboarding flow
